scope: health ingestion CPU optimization and owner revision range correctness
cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 9 H 365 w/ Radeon 880M

cpu_measurements.warning: CPU-only measurements. These are not database persistence, HTTP ingestion, multi-process cluster or provider delivery throughput.

sample_preparation.scope: one sample normalization, JSON encoding, JSON identity and SHA-256, immutable change event encoding
sample_preparation.change: reuse sample JSON already encoded before revision lock

batch_placeholders.scope: three SQL value lists for a 200-sample batch: identity lookup, 14-column sample rows, 4-column change rows
batch_placeholders.change: pre-size builder and replace fmt placeholder formatting with strconv

real_mysql_correctness.isolation: disposable dbtest databases, isolated scheduler window
verified_behaviors: existing-owner write commits independently of an uncommitted different-owner write
uncommitted changes do not appear in owner cursor pages
every accepted intermediate input version remains in immutable history
conflicting batches and range reservations roll back
range refill remains globally unique and owner-monotonic
safe JSON integer boundary truncates final range and rejects further writes
regressed global high-water mark is rejected
daily corrections, deletion, ownership and source isolation remain intact
authentication, CSRF, binding epochs and statistics remain intact

checks: change JSON bytes match encoding/json including escaped Unicode, time zone, nil device and deleted samples

verified_behaviors: eight transactions begin before a barrier releases simultaneous first writes to one absent owner
all transactions commit with distinct consecutive revisions 1 through 8
exactly one owner clock and one 65536-revision reservation exist
all eight sample and change records persist
concurrent_lazy_initialization.warning: Correctness test with database setup and cleanup timing, not a throughput measurement.

throughput_status: root is responsible for separate real multi-process measurements; no CPU-derived cluster throughput claim is made

implementation.cutover_requirement: stop all old-version writers before upgrade or rollback; do not mix old global-clock writers with new owner-range writers
